title: APPLIED RESEARCH ON ENVIRONMENTAL PSYCHOLOGY IN ARCHITECTURE ENVIRONMENT DESIGN

findings.antecedent: new dwelling environment (Hougou New Village)
findings.mechanism: Villagers considered it a beautiful home that completely overturns their perception, in stark contrast to the dilapidated surroundings of the ancient village, and used adjectives such as beautiful, new, attractive, and pastel to describe the environment.
findings.quote: First, in terms of aesthetic evaluation, the villagers gave an 'Excellent' rating on the aesthetic evaluation of the new dwelling environment.

findings.antecedent: new dwelling environment (Hougou New Village)
findings.mechanism: More than 85 percent of the villagers gave an 'Excellent' rating, but 15 percent said they were not very satisfied, believing the new environment lacks space to raise large livestock related to their previous farming life.
findings.quote: Secondly, the evaluation of environmental satisfaction was a 'Good' grade. More than 85 percent of the villagers gave an 'Excellent' rating, but 15 percent said they were not very satisfied.

findings.antecedent: new dwelling environment (Hougou New Village)
findings.mechanism: The 'General' rating is explained by the age of participants; most villagers over 55 years old retain nostalgia for the old village, while young people have higher emotional evaluation for the new village.
findings.quote: Thirdly, the evaluation of emotion, the villagers' evaluation of the new village environment is a 'General' grade.

findings.antecedent: new dwelling environment (Hougou New Village)
findings.mechanism: The new community environment makes up for many shortcomings of villagers living in the ancient village, meets the needs of most villagers, improves their sense of environmental experience, quality of life and happiness.
findings.quote: Finally, the ratings of the post-use evaluation showed consistency, and all the villagers' environmental evaluations reached a 'Good' rating.

findings.antecedent: Chinese folk Cultural Heritage Rescue Project memorial Hall design
findings.mechanism: Tourists and villagers showed a high degree of recognition, using adjectives such as grand, spectacular, distinctive, traditional, and charming to describe their love for the building.
findings.quote: First, this project received a rating of 'Excellent' in aesthetics. Tourists and villagers have shown a high degree of recognition of the design of the memorial hall...

findings.quote: Second, it received a 'Good' rating in terms of functionality.

findings.antecedent: Chinese folk Cultural Heritage Rescue Project memorial Hall design
findings.mechanism: The project has great emotional significance for locals and visitors due to its remote location and the architect's sincere emotion toward the native place, realizing empathy between site and people.

findings.antecedent: Chinese folk Cultural Heritage Rescue Project memorial Hall design

limitations: Some villagers believe the new Hougou New Village environment lacks space to raise large livestock because their previous way of life was related to farming labor.
Most villagers over 55 years old retain nostalgia for the old village life, affecting their emotional evaluation of the new village.

The interior part of the Chinese folk Cultural Heritage Rescue Project memorial Hall was still under construction and not fully open to the public, leading to a 'General' rating for post-use evaluation.
Tourists' evaluation of the visual design of scenic spots in the Tourist Reception Center declined, indicating a need to strengthen aesthetics and identification (e.g., road signs).
The planning of supporting facilities for new energy vehicles (charging system, exclusive area) was not fully considered in the Tourist Reception Center project.
Some tourists preferred to experience local traditional cave buildings for accommodation, suggesting possibilities for reusing vernacular buildings in Hougou Ancient Village.
The multimedia information device of the kindergarten entrance building facade could not be permitted in the later period, limiting the full reflection of the building's sociality.
The shared landscape designed in the periphery of the kindergarten park occupied part of the urban road system, preventing its full realization and affecting the functional evaluation.
Poor sealing performance of the perforated aluminum plate of the kindergarten entrance building curtain wall led to rain leakage, affecting aesthetics and increasing maintenance workload.
Children often used their hands to dig the carved aluminum plate of the kindergarten entrance building, posing security risks.
